hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — 6, 2, 5. You bet. Your opponent raised you back.
Turn — Ace. Your opponent bet out. You called.

wrongReasons: 7 4 makes a flush here — a hand that strong would have raised earlier and pushed harder for maximum value. The measured sizing in this hand points to something weaker.
With only high card, 7 Q wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
With only one pair, 7 6 wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 5 5

Your opponent flopped three of a kind and raised the flop immediately to build the pot. Sets are too strong to slow-play — they pushed their advantage on every street.
